# conductorone_recovery_policy (Resource)

RecoveryPolicy Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "conductorone_recovery_policy" "my_recoverypolicy" {
  allowed_recovery_types = [
    "CREDENTIAL_TYPE_EMAIL_OTP"
  ]
  display_name            = "...my_display_name..."
  min_recovery_auth_level = "AUTH_LEVEL_NONE"
  priority                = 6
  recovery_policy_service_delete_request = {
    # ...
  }
  revoke_on_recovery = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `display_name` (String) A human-readable name for the policy.

### Optional

- `allowed_recovery_types` (List of String) The credential types a user may use to recover access.
- `min_recovery_auth_level` (String) The minimum assurance level a recovery ceremony must reach. possible known values include one of ["AUTH_LEVEL_UNSPECIFIED", "AUTH_LEVEL_NONE", "AUTH_LEVEL_SINGLE_FACTOR", "AUTH_LEVEL_MULTI_FACTOR", "AUTH_LEVEL_PHR", "AUTH_LEVEL_PHRH"]
- `priority` (Number) When a user matches more than one policy, the policy with the highest
 priority applies.
- `recovery_policy_service_delete_request` (Attributes) The RecoveryPolicyServiceDeleteRequest message. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--recovery_policy_service_delete_request))
- `revoke_on_recovery` (Boolean) When true, a successful recovery revokes existing credentials and forces
 re-enrollment.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the policy.
- `is_builtin` (Boolean) True for built-in policies provided by ConductorOne. Built-in policies
 cannot be edited or deleted.
- `updated_at` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = conductorone_recovery_policy.my_conductorone_recovery_policy
  id = "..."
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import conductorone_recovery_policy.my_conductorone_recovery_policy "..."
```
